div.head: Af 40.1
div.ab: Gif þysses hwæt gelimpe, þonne fyrd ute sy, oþþe in lencten-fæsten, hit sy twybote.
Gif ðisses hwæt gelimpe, ðenden fyrd ute sie, oððe in lenctenfæsten, hit sie twybote.
Si horum aliquid eueniat, quando exercitus foris est, uel in quadragesimali ieiunio, sit dupliciter emendandum.
Gif ðisses hwæt gelimpe, ðenden fyrd ute sie, oððe in lenctenfæsten, hit sie twybote.
If something of this nature occurs while the army is out [on duty], or in the Lenten fast, it is double compensation.
If any of these offences occur while the army is in the field, or during the fast of Lent, the compensation [to be paid] shall be double [the above].
If any of this happens when the army has been called out, or in the Lenten fast, the compensations are to be doubled.
Wenn etwas derart geschieht, während die Landwehr auswärts ist, oder in den Frühlingsfasten, stehe es unter Doppelbusse.
If anything of this kind happens while the army is out, or in the Lenten fast, let it be subject to double compensation.
